digest.component_or_area: configuration management and composition ownership enforcement
propositions: Direct or aliased ambient configuration/credential reads (load_config, os.getenv, os.environ access forms, backend property reload, configurable adapter defaults) must be rejected below approved composition seams unless explicitly registered with an owner and rationale.

An AST ownership gate must deterministically enforce that every declared configuration and credential name has exactly one approved owner seam, with synthetic tests for prohibited access patterns and unowned registry entries.
Configuration precedence, lifecycle, security, and operator documentation must be auto-generated from authoritative schema/ownership registries and kept in sync via drift checks.
All S1-S6 behavioral correctness suites must pass after legacy facades, per-job SSM paths, and migration exception entries are removed.
Bounded live canaries (provider, AWS review-bot/op-cert, reconciler check/dry-run/live) must pass with redacted evidence and no unauthorized fallback before legacy removal is finalized.
